title: K-Means Clustering in Python: A Practical Guide
description: Learn how to perform k-means clustering in Python with scikit-learn, choose the right number of clusters, and build an end-to-end clustering pipeline.
summary: The k -means clustering method is an unsupervised machine learning technique used to identify clusters of data objects in a dataset. There are many different types of clustering methods, but k -means is one of the oldest and most approachable.
takeaways: If you’re interested in learning how and when to implement k -means clustering in Python, then this is the right place.
You’ll walk through an end-to-end example of k -means clustering using Python, from preprocessing the data to evaluating results.
